verdict.rationale: Puzzle's API supports platform-to-platform integration and journal entries can be created/edited/imported (docs-42, docs-43, docs-31/35), and AI Close uses agents to reconcile and 'review transactions' (docs-24/39), suggesting some agent-assisted, human-reviewed workflow exists. However, there is no documented API endpoint or feature specifically for an agent to draft a journal entry and place it into a distinct 'review queue' state pending accountant approval — the evidence only shows batch/manual entry creation and general AI-close reconciliation, not a draft-and-queue mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit API support for draft/pending journal entry status, a documented review-queue or approval workflow accessible to accountants, and confirmation that AI-drafted entries route through this queue rather than posting directly.
